signals.name: equalsCount
signals.quantity: number of ConnectionSource.equals(Object) invocations during one fuzz execution
signals.reset: V1Counters.reset() called in V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

plans.retention: Primary: retain inputs whose equalsCount exceeds 90% of the global best; always retain new global bests. Secondary (flat-signal / growth phase): retain inputs that are longer than any previously retained input, to grow toward input_bytes.
mutation: diversify-all-records: for every record in the input, independently randomize each non-overlapping 2-byte atom by a random delta that preserves the base-31 polynomial contribution (31*a+b=C), converting duplicate records into distinct connection IDs sharing the same hash bucket; produces up to 9^5=59049 unique colliding IDs for 10-byte IDs
hash-preserving byte-pair: change one 2-byte atom in one random record by (+delta, -31*delta) for fine-grained variation
whole-input doubling: concatenate input with itself for rapid size growth toward input_bytes
record repetition: duplicate a random length-prefixed record 4-64 times for density growth
